Any future request for ACME listening-monitor volume/sentiment data will fail the same way until the credential's entitlements are updated - check for the 403 before assuming a query parameter mistake, and tell the user upfront that listening data is inaccessible with this credential rather than retrying variations.

ACME's owned social profiles (via `acme` API connection, GET /insights/profiles): id 701 "ACME Corp" (linkedin, created 2026-01-05) is the main/primary owned profile — the only one named exactly after the company and the earliest created. Other owned profiles: 702 "ACME Support" (x), 703 "ACME Careers" (linkedin), 704 "ACME Labs" (mastodon), 705 "ACME Retail" (instagram).

For deduplicated reach over a date range, use GET /insights/profiles/{id}/metrics:aggregate (operation_id aggregate_profile_metrics) with start_date/end_date — it returns {groups:[{key:"impressions"|"engagements"|"unique_reach", value}]} already deduplicated over the whole window. Do NOT sum unique_reach from the daily/weekly GET /insights/profiles/{id}/metrics (list_profile_metrics) series — those unique_reach values are per-bucket and double-count accounts reached on multiple days.

Example: profile 701 unique_reach for 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28 = 85,278 (engagements 23,934; impressions 345,204).
